text: 中国银行AH股齐创历史新高，A股涨近3%，H股涨超4%；公司此前发布中期业绩：股东应享税后利润1235.94亿元，同比增加5.1%。
text_en: Bank of China's A-shares and H-shares both hit record highs, with A-shares rising nearly 3% and H-shares up over 4%; the company earlier posted interim results: net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 123.594 billion, up 5.1% year-on-year.
